Tara: Starting a quick 7-day access review sprint for stale admin grants. Need SOC2-grade evidence capture and KMS-safe removals.
Evan: Scope?
Tara: prod+staging roles, svcaccts included. Criteria: last-used > 150d OR missing owner tag.
Mei: KMS note: snapshot grants before changing IAM. I'll run `aws kms list-grants --key-id $K --output json > /tmp/$K-grants.json` and upload to s3.
KeyOpsBot: Keys tagged `sensitive=true` require KeyOps signoff within 48h before any grant changes.
AuditBot: Created ticket SEC-522 and attached placeholder cloudtrail slice. Evidence path: s3://sec-evidence/sec-522/.
Tara: Playbook sketch:
1) `./tools/find_ownerless_roles --days 150 > candidates.txt`
2) for each role: tag `review:pending`, snapshot grants, run `./tools/check_cross_bindings --role ROLE`
3) notify owners with evidence links, wait 72h for justification
4) svcacct no-response -> revoke inline policies + document `RevokeGrant` calls
Evan: Escalation for contested removals?
Tara: contested -> ping #eng-security-oncall + SecLead. 24h hold, then require SecLead+Ops signoff. Document approvals in SEC-522.
Mei: I'll start grant snapshots and upload manifests. Will redact PII per Legal before attaching.
Sam: I'll wire the notify zap and include cloudtrail + s3 links.
AuditBot: SEC-522 updated: grants_manifest.csv uploaded.
Tara: Thanks. Flag false positives in-thread. Mid-sprint check in 3 days. :white_check_mark:
